c01-bundle.chapter: II · Votes to One Man, Bundles to All
c01-bundle.note: The bundle: three sealed cords tied together, carried by a rat to the chink in the wall.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic dusk photograph with the same camera and composition, Hellenistic Greece, 3rd century BC. None of its smooth surfaces survive: real limestone, dry-stone, earth, scrub. At dusk, close on a chink at the foot of a small ruined cyclopean dry-stone wall. A single brown rat stands at the chink, a bundle of three short cords tied together on its back, each cord ending in a small dab of dark red sealing wax stamped with a different man's number in upright strokes: one with Ι, one with ΙΙ, one with ΙΙΙ. Exactly three seals, each turned to the camera and clearly visible. Dry grass, stones. No people, no fire. Everything sharp. No text except the strokes on the seals. Period: Hellenistic Greece, 3rd century BC. Every garment is one loom-woven rectangle, pinned or belted: no set-in sleeves, no togas, no stripe or band across the body, no buckles, no stitched bags. Everyone is an adult unless named otherwise. No glass panes, no hourglasses, no agave or prickly pear, no whitewashed Cycladic houses, no Viking or medieval ships, no lens flare. Each seal is a small dab of dark red sealing wax pressed with its owner's signet ring, which is cut with the owner's number in upright Attic strokes: Ι, ΙΙ, ΙΙΙ or ΙΙΙΙ. Never a picture, an animal, a plant, a face or an emblem; never letters.

cover.note: Cover (3:4). People are added in the image pass.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic dusk photograph with the same camera and composition, Hellenistic Greece, 3rd century BC. None of its smooth surfaces survive: real limestone, dry-stone, earth, scrub; blob trees become real pines. A lookout post on a steep slope among pale crags, a low rough dry-stone breastwork of uneven loose stones in front. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its bandit's dress exactly (slate grey tunic and cloak, bronze bracers). He sits alone behind the breastwork, head and shoulders above it, tying three short sealed cords together into one bundle with both hands; on the stones beside him a single brown rat waits. No fire, no other people. Nothing modern.
